# Whole-input level study — preregistered local protocol

Pinned stock1.3.2 and unmodified ng88601f0bdd192e9f87d4bd0a50d5d2e2dc9b8cd0 from production3f71d03f3297f94e8c2cc34160262a880be337fc. No retired tree prototype or production edit. Sizes32/64/128/256/512/1024/4096, nine deterministic corpora: three retained original prefixes, valid repetitive JSON string, JSON records, short natural text, one repeated byte, SHAKE256 random bytes, mixed patterns. Every byte array is the entire input known before FINISH, never a guessed stream size from a first chunk.

Stock and ng physical levels1–6 are individually measured. Six primary stock6-v-ng6/5/4/3/2/1 contrasts, five remaining equal-level contrasts, stock1-v-ng2 for current Java requested1, and five direct ng6-v-lower-level contrasts. Equal numbers are not equivalent algorithms. Default ng1 quick,2 fast,3–4 medium,5–6 medium_fizzle; preprocessor features are retained. Requested6 remains6; requested1→ng2 is a labeled existing mapping, not a policy selected here.

Every corpus/size/level output is decompressed with pinned stock in wrapped and raw formats. Both ng namespaces must emit exactly equal bytes. Input and output hashes, absolute byte differences and compressed-size ratios versus stock6 and ng6 are retained. The six-byte wrapper overhead is verified, not used to exaggerate tiny ratios.

PREDECLARED criterion:100ns absolute meaningful latency difference. All pre/post A/A cells require abs(mean of12 block paired means)+2.201*SEM <=100ns. Two-state A/A also retains the same bound for the fixed owned-slot contrast so reversed logical assignments cannot hide it. Any failure makes all comparative timing unqualified. Every sample stays included; no retry, threshold change or past-offset subtraction.

One timing process with unchanged mappings:36 pre A/A cells (three controls ×two sizes[Java64,mixed4096] ×two formats ×reset/reuse/create),4284 comparative cells,36 post A/A. AA12blocks×20 balanced pairs×128 operations. Comparisons6blocks×6 balanced pairs,32 operations through1KiB and8 at4KiB;32 warmups per logical arm per block. Comparative initialization order reverses each block; all streams permanently own their initializing API. Two-state AA reverses logical assignments by block; separate-image AA stays fixed. Clocks are per batch; wall/threadCPU, contexts, faults, throttle counters, output lengths, addresses and initialization ordinals are retained. Missing controller fields are not proof of zero throttling.

Whole schedule runs once even if calibration fails. A TIMING_STARTED marker prevents an accidental second invocation in the same output directory. Qualified pairwise speed requires an interval beyond100ns and all AA gates; means and point Pareto fronts are descriptive, with uncertain/unpaired lower-level rankings explicitly unknown. No new compression default is selected.

Run `python3 run.py --root REPOSITORY --phase prepare`, then `--phase sizes`, then `--phase timing`; analyze with `python3 analyze.py`. `--phase all` does all once. `--corpora CHECKOUT` accepts the fixed corpus revision; otherwise local Git objects supply it. `--out DIRECTORY` chooses a separate writable artifact directory. No network publication is part of these commands.
